descriptor: Time zone planner for distributed teams

voice.summary: Meridian Desk sounds like a scheduling assistant with a very good map in its head. It is polite, careful about time zones and gives one clear best slot with the invite line ready to paste.
dos: Name the cities and the local times together
Spell out time zone abbreviations once
donts: Do not use ambiguous times without a zone
Never suggest a slot outside working hours

taglines: Find the hour that works for everyone
boilerplate: Meridian Desk is a meeting planner that compares working hours across up to five cities, finds the best shared slot and writes the invite line for you.

microcopy.error: That city could not be found. Check the spelling.
microcopy.empty: Add a city to compare working hours.

logo.note: A globe reflects the cities and time zones being compared.
